title: "End of Maths Trail Questionnaire (E)"
format: html
code-fold: True

We hope that you have enjoyed the Mathematics Trail today. At the various stops we have provided an overview of an important principles and interactive widgets for you to explore a mathematical idea. Note that behind each widget is a set of mathematical equations that are being solved using your phone. The mathematical details in these widgets are important but there is not enough time to go into that today!  


##  Feedback form

Please fill in our brief Maths Trail Questionnaire which will help us to improve future events:

<https://forms.cloud.microsoft/e/BfRM8a7rga>

## Share your trail on Instagram

If you enjoyed the trail we would like you to post about it on your social networks so that other can too! 
Snap a photo of your favourite discovery from today's trail and share it on Instagram. If you tag **@dundeemaths** then some of our undergraduate students will be able to answer any questions that you might have about the tour.


If you tag **@dundeeuni** you can let the University of Dundee know how much you appreciate both Mathematics and the Botanic Gardens!

```{=html}
<div id="ig-note">
  On your phone, "Post your photo" jumps straight to Instagram's camera so you can snap and post right away --
  Instagram doesn't let a website fill in the photo or the @dundeemaths tag for you, so just add that yourself
  before you share.
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var postBtn = document.getElementById("ig-post-btn");
  if (!postBtn) return;

  // Instagram has no "compose a post" web link, and no way for a website to
  // pre-attach a photo or a tag to someone's post -- that's a deliberate
  // platform restriction, not something we can work around. The closest a
  // link can get: on a phone with the Instagram app installed, the
  // instagram://camera deep link jumps straight to the in-app camera ready
  // to start a new post. If that fails (desktop, or app not installed), we
  // fall back to the normal profile page after a short delay.
  postBtn.addEventListener("click", function (evt) {
    var isMobile = /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
    if (!isMobile) return; // desktop: just follow the normal profile link

    evt.preventDefault();
    var fallbackUrl = postBtn.href;

    // Navigating the main window straight to an unknown "instagram://" link
    // shows an ugly browser error page on some devices if the app isn't
    // installed. Attempting it from a hidden iframe instead means a failed
    // attempt just fails quietly there, leaving this page alone -- the
    // fallback timer below then sends the visitor to the profile page.
    var iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
    iframe.style.display = "none";
    document.body.appendChild(iframe);

    var fallbackTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      window.location.href = fallbackUrl;
    }, 1200);

    function cancelFallback() {
      clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
      window.removeEventListener("blur", cancelFallback);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibilityChange);
    }
    function onVisibilityChange() {
      if (document.hidden) cancelFallback();
    }
    window.addEventListener("blur", cancelFallback);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibilityChange);

    try {
      iframe.src = "instagram://camera";
    } catch (e) {
      clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
      window.location.href = fallbackUrl;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```
